bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
py="$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python"
client="$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
"$py" -B "$client" health || exit 71
row=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -F '|' -c "SELECT t.chat_id,d.telegram_message_id,CASE WHEN d.rendered_text LIKE '%✅ 終了%' THEN 'FINISHED' WHEN d.rendered_text LIKE '%🔴 LIVE中%' THEN 'LIVE' ELSE 'OTHER' END FROM posting_deliveries d JOIN announcement_posts a ON a.announcement_id::text=d.source_id JOIN room_posts r ON r.room_id=a.room_id JOIN posting_topics t ON t.topic_id=d.posting_topic_id WHERE d.source_type='announcement' AND r.status='finished' AND d.status='sent' AND d.telegram_message_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.chat_id,d.telegram_message_id LIMIT 1") || exit 72
test -n "$row" || exit 73
IFS='|' read -r chat mid dbmark <<EOF
$row
EOF
echo DB_FIRST_CARD_MARKER="$dbmark"
if "$py" -B "$client" room_public_readback --chat-id "$chat" --message-id "$mid"; then echo TELEGRAM_FIRST_CARD=READABLE; else echo TELEGRAM_FIRST_CARD=NOT_VERIFIED; fi
"$py" -B "$client" health || exit 74
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 75
echo JOINED_DIALOG_REAL_TEST_DONE
